title: Deterministic engine state and seeded RNG
prompt: Implement only the first deterministic engine foundation defined by RULES-SPEC-v1.md. Keep it pure TypeScript with no UI, browser, Capacitor, or Firebase imports. Add focused unit tests that prove equal seed plus equal inputs creates equal results.
acceptance: The engine exports a small typed state/RNG surface with no platform dependencies.
Tests prove deterministic output for identical seeds and inputs.
The package lint, typecheck, test and build scripts pass.
